Priya Sharma
Lead QA Automation & Quality Architect
Denver, CO | priya.sharma@testpro.io | +1 303-555-0188 | linkedin.com/in/priyasharma-qa | github.com/priyasharma-automation

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Lead QA Automation Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing robust test automation frameworks for web, mobile, and API microservices. Expert in Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, TypeScript, Jest, and Postman within Agile CI/CD environments. Proven track record of increasing automated test coverage from 35% to 92% and slashing regression test execution cycles from 4 days to 45 minutes.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Lead QA Automation Engineer | Apex Cloud Enterprise | Denver, CO | 2021 - Present
- Designed and implemented unified end-to-end test automation framework using TypeScript, Playwright, and Docker, executing 1,800+ automated tests across Chrome, Firefox, and WebKit.
- Reduced full regression test suite execution time by 82% (from 4 hours to 45 minutes) by orchestrating parallel test execution across GitHub Actions runners.
- Built comprehensive REST and GraphQL API testing suite using Supertest and Jest, achieving 96% API endpoint coverage and catching 35+ critical defects pre-release.
- Integrated automated performance and load testing using k6 and Grafana, identifying database bottlenecks prior to Black Friday traffic surge of 50,000 concurrent users.
- Led quality assurance strategy across 6 engineering squads, establishing quality gates, code coverage thresholds, and defect triage workflows.

Senior QA Automation Engineer | PeakWave Media | Boulder, CO | 2017 - 2021
- Created modular UI test automation framework in Cypress and JavaScript, increasing test coverage across core user journeys from 30% to 88%.
- Integrated automated tests into Jenkins CI/CD pipeline, preventing broken builds and reducing production bug escape rate by 60%.
- Conducted mobile app automated testing on real device clouds using Appium, BrowserStack, and Sauce Labs for iOS and Android.
- Authored detailed test plans, risk matrices, and test summary reports in Jira and Xray Test Management.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Colorado Boulder | 2013 - 2017

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Automation Frameworks: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver, Appium, Puppeteer
- Languages & Tools: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, SQL, Git, Docker
- API & Performance Testing: Postman, Newman, REST Assured, Supertest, k6, JMeter, Charles Proxy
- CI/CD & Test Management: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Jira, Xray, Zephyr, TestRail
- Methodologies: BDD (Cucumber), TDD, Shift-Left Testing, Agile, Scrum, Regression Testing

CERTIFICATIONS
- ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level - Test Automation Engineer (2022)
- ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) (2018)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Lead QA Automation Engineer to drive quality engineering. Requirements:
- 7+ years QA experience with extensive automated testing in Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
- Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, and API automated testing.
- Hands-on experience integrating test suites with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Jenkins).
- Leadership experience designing test frameworks and mentoring QA teams.
